timing.scope: Natural frame-correspondence mismatch in a real Seedance 2.0 output. Not independent proof that the model literally deleted a source frame.
timing.excerpt_selection: Contiguous six-second action excerpt. No internal frames removed, duplicated, retimed or shifted. Full-take analysis already identifies the same gap at plate frame 96; late ambiguous regions are not claimed as repaired.
timing.psnr_scope: Timing-only stage: decoded output vs matching decoded input at 640px width before fixed framing; H.264 re-encoding changes pixels.
timing.source_proxy_correspondence: All 192 proxy frames match their original native-1080p indices; no proxy-induced timing gap.

framing.scope: Real timing mismatch plus one fixed framing correction; not whole-frame identity or general stabilization.

residual_motion.headline: Mostly fixed framing; no clear progressive drift
residual_motion.action: Inspect the corrected comparison. No per-frame stabilisation is indicated by these measurements.

extension.operation: Explicit editorial tail extension, not an automatically detected model failure
extension.delivery_crop: Remove 4px top and bottom spatial padding only
extension.method: Native Windows ComfyUI LTX 2.5 continuation, followed by PlateLock genfill.save_patches context colour match and target-only merge. Existing AI frames copied in order; H.264 delivery re-encodes the complete clip.
extension.limitation: Plausible continuation; original plate trajectory and exact original pixels are not guaranteed. Separate advanced workflow, not Studio automatic missing-footage validation.
extension.decoded_prefix_check: All 193 decoded output frames compared to original at 640px width, same indices; H.264 changes pixels.

rejected_candidate.reason: Weak sequence confidence in the first two segments. Not used as a timing-repair proof or as the demo source.
